note: **Lincoln Villa and North Lodge, schedules 202 and 203 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Three unmarried Bright siblings still in their father's house at 11 Western Terrace, and a boarding house of thirteen on North Lodge of whom seven are government staff. North Lodge is not in the property list, so schedule 203 is unfiled.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
